description: The line plot, titled “BBQ,” illustrates the accuracy performance of four different methods—Squared Exponential, Tanh, ELU, and LLaMA-2-chat-7B—across a range of x-axis values from 0 to 1500, which likely represent training steps, layer indices, or spectral editing thresholds. The x-axis is linearly scaled with major tick marks at intervals of 250. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 45 to 55 and is also linearly scaled, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The “Squared Exponential” method is represented by a solid dark blue line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 53.5 at x=0, rises to about 55.5 by x=250, and remains nearly flat thereafter. The “Tanh” method, shown as a solid medium blue line with circular markers, begins near 50, slightly increases to around 50.5 by x=1000, and then plateaus. The “ELU” method, depicted with a solid light blue line and circular markers, starts near 49.5, dips slightly to about 49 by x=500, then gradually rises to approximately 50 by x=1500. The “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” baseline is shown as a dashed pink line with no markers, remaining nearly constant at approximately 46.5 across the entire x-axis range. All lines are plotted with consistent marker spacing, and the legend is positioned in the upper right corner for clarity.
